content.short: zkBob Private Wallet enables secure, anonymous, limited-value token transfers for users.
content.description: zkBob Private Wallet enables secure, anonymous, limited-value token transfers for everyday use. It supports WETH, ETH, USDC, and BOB. After a token is deposited into the zkBob wallet, pool participants can transfer funds to one another privately and securely, with privacy preserved throughout the process. This makes it suitable for activities such as private payrolls, charitable donations, fundraising campaigns, and other small-value transfers where confidentiality matters. The design emphasizes straightforward, accessible transfers that minimize exposure while keeping control within the intended pool participants.
